outcome: Refused the Nightingale oath but accepted a separate bargain to serve as an Agent of Nocturnal.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "I chose not to become a Nightingale. Instead, Val and I have become Agents of Nocturnal of a different variety... We are less powerful than Nightingales, but our souls remain our own."
branch_note: Alternative to the vanilla Nightingale oath; the s210 branch duplicates accepting that vanilla oath and is not rowed.

outcome: Relented and returned the Skeleton Key to appease Nocturnal.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "I've relented and given the Skeleton Key to the Wraiths-of-Crows sent by Nocturnal. This appeased Nocturnal and her Daedra no longer hunt me."
branch_note: Terminal of the keep-the-Key consequence arc.

quest_name: Between the Daedra and the Deep Blue Sea
outcome: Rescued Val Serano after he was marooned on a deserted island.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "I've rescued a man named Val Serano from a deserted island."
branch_note: Single outcome; aid to a stranded person is explicit.

outcome: Passed a forged relic to Solitude's guard to clear Val's name.
citation: s40 journal: "Val has no intention of returning the real relic to Solitude. Instead, he plans to substitute a forgery."; s80 objective: Give the fake Star of Solitude to Captain Aldis; s90 journal: "I've helped Val clear his name in Solitude, but at what cost to my own reputation?" RUNTIME-VERIFY: the quest has no CompleteQuest flag.
branch_note: Terminal recorded stage despite missing completion flag.

outcome: Crafted and gave Val a set of mage robes to celebrate completing his studies.
citation: s10 objective: Craft the Seafaring Mage Robes and Boots at a tanning rack; s30 journal: "To celebrate him completing his studies at the College of Winterhold, I crafted and gave him a set of mage robes." RUNTIME-VERIFY: the quest has no CompleteQuest flag.
branch_note: Single crafted-gift outcome.

outcome: Committed to a shared future with Val after the first romance path.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val and I have decided to chart our course together."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive positive romance terminal; route variant 1 of 3.

outcome: Committed to a shared future with Val after the second romance path.
citation: s300 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val and I have decided to chart our course together."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive positive romance terminal; route variant 2 of 3.

outcome: Committed to a shared future with Val after the third romance path.
citation: s400 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val and I have decided to chart our course together."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive positive romance terminal; route variant 3 of 3.

quest_name: But You Have Heard of Me
outcome: Spared Tarek Serano after defeating the Dark Rose mutineers.
citation: s60 journal: "His father's fate is in my hands."; s70: "I've allowed Tarek Serano to leave with his life."; s200 [COMPLETE]: "We defeated the mutineers from the Dark Rose but allowed Tarek to live."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive with killing Tarek at s201.

quest_name: But You Have Heard of Me
outcome: Killed Tarek Serano after the defeated pirate's fate was placed in the player's hands.
citation: s60 journal: "His father's fate is in my hands."; s71: "I've slain Tarek Serano."; s201 [COMPLETE]: "We defeated the mutineers from the Dark Rose and slew Tarek."
branch_note: The explicit spare-or-kill decision occurs after the battle; this is not honorable combat.

quest_name: Drink and the Daedra Had Done for the Rest
outcome: Defeated Molag Bal's servants and freed Fathis from the Prince's imprisonment.
citation: s55 journal: "Fathis... is now in the clutches of Molag Bal. It is up to me and Val to rescue him."; s70: "We've defeated Molag Bal's forces and can now free Fathis"; s200 [COMPLETE]: "Val and I rescued Fathis from a fate worse than death."
branch_note: Single rescue and anti-domination outcome.

outcome: Rescued an injured Val from the Falmer and reaffirmed their mutual commitment.
citation: s80 journal: "I've found Val and healed him of his injuries."; s200 [COMPLETE]: "I rescued Val from a terrible fate... I will always be there for him, just as he'll always be there for me."
branch_note: Romance terminal; mutually exclusive with the friendship ending.

outcome: Rescued an injured Val from the Falmer and preserved their friendship.
citation: s80 journal: "I've found Val and healed him of his injuries."; s211 [COMPLETE]: "I rescued Val from a terrible fate... We'll remain friends."
branch_note: Friendship terminal; mutually exclusive with the romance ending.

outcome: Adopted the orphaned child Ravani with Val and welcomed her into the family.
citation: s80 journal: "Val and I have adopted a little Dunmer girl named Ravani."; s90 [COMPLETE]: "we've decided to adopt her and raise her as our own."
branch_note: Adoption branch; mutually exclusive with the no-children ending.

outcome: Talked Val through his fears about fatherhood and committed to raising children together.
citation: s25 journal: "Val shared with me his fears about being a father."; s200 [COMPLETE]: "Val and I talked through his worries about being a father. In time, he'll grow into the role."
branch_note: Parenthood branch; mutually exclusive with adoption and no-children endings.

outcome: Had the Skeleton Key returned to its proper resting place and restored Nocturnal's favor.
citation: s201 [COMPLETE] journal: "Karliah will return the Skeleton Key to its proper resting place... her full Nightingale status will be restored."
branch_note: Final return-the-Key branch; earlier parallel quest stages are not rowed.

outcome: Kept the Skeleton Key for its power despite Nocturnal's anger.
citation: s202 [COMPLETE] journal: "The Skeleton Key and its ability to unlock unlimited potential are mine... this will surely anger Nocturnal."
branch_note: Final keep-the-Key branch; mutually exclusive with s201.

outcome: Stole the College's rings while helping Val prepare a Conjuration ritual.
citation: s82 journal: "First, I'll need to obtain the rings from the Arcanaeum without Urag noticing."; objective s82: Obtain the rings by stealth.
branch_note: Mutually exclusive acquisition method with the distraction at s84.

outcome: Distracted Urag so Val could take the College's rings unnoticed.
citation: s84 journal: "First, I'll need to speak with Urag in the Arcaneum as a distraction while Val obtains the rings."; objective s84: Distract Urag while Val obtains the rings.
branch_note: Mutually exclusive acquisition method with theft at s82.

outcome: Helped Val master a difficult Conjuration working and studied the defeated golem's magic.
citation: s165 journal: "We defeated the golem after a fierce battle. By studying it's remains, we were able to learn numerous new and powerful spells. Val has truly become a master mage."
branch_note: Successful study terminal; the quest record carries no CompleteQuest flag at this stage.

outcome: Refused to help Val summon a Dremora for a dangerous master-level spell.
citation: s199 journal: "Val wanted to summon a Dremora to obtain a Sigil Stone for a master-level Conjuration spell, but I'll have no part of it."
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: refuse_reckless_magic; rejecting a non-Prince summoning is not destroy_reject_daedra.

quest_name: Making an Honest Man of Him
outcome: Married Val in a commitment ceremony aboard the Dark Rose.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "After a commitment ceremony on the Dark Rose, Val and I are happily married. Time to start the next chapter of our lives, together."
branch_note: Shipboard wedding branch.

quest_name: Making an Honest Man of Him
outcome: Married Val in a ceremony at the Temple of Mara.
citation: s201 [COMPLETE] journal: "After a ceremony at the Temple of Mara, Val and I are happily married. Time to start the next chapter of our lives, together."
branch_note: Temple wedding branch; no honor_divine tag because the act is marriage rather than worship.

quest_name: Making an Honest Man of Him
outcome: Rejected marriage while affirming a lasting loving commitment to Val.
citation: s202 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val asked me to marry him, but marriage just isn't for me. Our committment to love each other is enough."
branch_note: Commitment-without-marriage branch; eligible under the locked romance ruling.

outcome: Allowed Val to bargain with Hermaeus Mora for knowledge needed to save Fathis.
citation: s20 objective: Intervene or allow Val to bargain; s22 journal: "Val made a bargain with Hermaus Mora to get information about Fathis... these bargains are never without a price."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive with preventing the bargain at s24.

outcome: Prevented Val from bargaining with Hermaeus Mora.
citation: s20 objective: Intervene or allow Val to bargain; s24 journal: "I prevented Val from bargaining with Hermaeus Mora... it's for the best."
branch_note: Mutually exclusive with accepting the bargain at s22.

outcome: Recovered and read Fathis's journal from Apocrypha to learn how to save him.
citation: s70 objective: Take the journal; s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "One of Fathis' journals somehow ended up in Apocrypha. Upon reading it, Val had an idea about where to search next."
branch_note: Successful-search terminal.

outcome: Recovered and read Fathis's journal after abandoning the full search of Apocrypha.
citation: s201 [COMPLETE] journal: "Although I didn't complete my search... I managed to locate one of Fathis' journals. Upon reading it, Val had an idea about where to search next."
branch_note: Abbreviated-search terminal; mutually exclusive with s200.

outcome: Betrayed Val's trust and turned the relationship into a fatal confrontation.
citation: s10 journal: "I've betrayed Val's trust."; objective s10: Defend yourself, traitor!
branch_note: Shared betrayal stage before the two fatal endings.

outcome: Killed and consumed Val in Namira's name.
citation: s201 [COMPLETE] journal: "I succumed to my cannibalistic hungers and consumed Val in Namira's name."
branch_note: Namira ending; mutually exclusive with the self-defense ending.

outcome: Shared a romantic walk with Val overlooking the Sea of Ghosts.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val invited me to take a walk with him in Solitude. We admired the view of the Sea of Ghosts together. I think Val was admiring me, too."
branch_note: Positive date terminal; the platonic refusal is not rowed.

outcome: Spent a romantic day boating with Val and acknowledged the growing relationship.
citation: s200 [COMPLETE] journal: "Val invited me to join him for an outing on Lake Ilinalta. He made it clear that he's interested in me as more than just a friend."
branch_note: Positive date terminal; mutually exclusive with refusal endings.
